problem_statement: The LTV helper set has no way to reorder a list of LTV append entries to minimize the encoded length of the MAC extension header. Callers must keep entries in their original order, which prevents adjacent LTVs from using the compact packed format even when reordering would allow them to pack, producing a longer encoded header. A new helper is needed that, given an array of LTV append entries and a count, rearranges them in place so that as many entries as possible use the packed format, yielding a shorter overall encoded length; re-optimizing an already-optimized list must be a no-op and preserve order on ties.
